summary: 6 posts, 539 views/30 days. Reels outperform static. Top reels use collab with editorxyz_official. Both analyzed reels have >60% skip rate — hooks fail in first 3s. 0 IG DMs. Views mostly from feed (61%) and profile (24%), near-zero explore. Shares high on speed-reel (51%), near-zero on sample-site reel.
guidance:
- Hook style to try next: open with a real client pain point on screen (e.g., "Hotel owner: 'My site loads in 8 seconds'") then cut to your fix in 1s. Rotate: problem→proof, speed demo, before/after scroll.
- Avoid repeating: generic "services overview" carousels, "DM now" without visible result, presenter talking without screen capture.
- Reminder: every post must show actual code/design you built — live preview, admin panel, mobile scroll. No stock footage, no agency-speak.

instructions.research: Find 3 Himachal hotel/homestay Instagram pages with broken/slow sites; screenshot their mobile load time.
instructions.analysis: Compare the two collab reels: list exact first-3-second frames; note where retention flattens.
instructions.writer: Write a 40-char Hinglish hook for a reel: "Hotel site 8s → 1.2s. Dekho kaise."
instructions.image: Create a split-screen carousel: left = client's old site (blurred URL), right = your 24hr rebuild (live link in bio).
instructions.video: Record a 15s reel: phone screen recording of you deploying a cafe site to Netlify, timer overlay, zero talking.

manual_tips: Comment on 5 Himachal cafe/hotel posts with a genuine compliment + "Saw your mobile site loads slow — happy to share a 30s fix video if useful."
Reply to every story mention/tag from editorxyz_official collab with a thank-you and a behind-the-scenes detail.
Add a WhatsApp click-to-chat link in bio (wa.me/91XXXXXXXXXX) and test it from a second phone.
